BUILD NOTES

WRITING pulls from https://chinonsoobeta.substack.com/feed — title, subtitle, date and the image enclosure, newest first. Rows link out; nothing is hosted here.

NOW LISTENING is manually updated, not scraped. Apple Music has no simple public now-playing endpoint. A data file in the repo holding track, artist, album, artwork and a link is enough.

STILL LIVE: online status, local time and weather. Each needs a source and a resting state for when it's down.

FOOTER is the same three links everywhere: email, github, substack. Instagram deferred.

Placeholder image wells stand in for real Substack thumbnails and album art.

QUIET INDEX — not chosen.
One column, serif, warm paper. Ships as static files with no integrations at all.

Kept here in case you want to pull anything from it.

BROADSHEET — not chosen.
Newspaper structure: masthead, live ticker, departments, 'Now' as the lead story.

Kept here in case you want to pull anything from it.
